generation.prompt_exact:
Use the PROVIDED FIRST IMAGE (own-generated canonical deergrass) for healthy Muhlenbergia rigens morphology and subdued olive-green/straw palette. The SECOND AND THIRD images are two existing deergrass leaf-fan source parts that will be reused unchanged. MATCH their fine-bladed naturalistic pixel material, upper-left light and modest three-quarter side garden perspective. Generate ONLY ONE REPLACEMENT LOW FIBROUS BASAL ROOT CROWN, not a full grass plant or replacement upper fans. Actual RGBA with TRUE transparent background. Output1024x1024 square with the entire LOW WIDE crown centered, occupying roughly65percent width and25percent height, with generous transparent margins on every side. No text, guides, labels, UI, birds, animals, scenery, soil tile, pots, pebbles or rocks. No cast-shadow haze or background/checkerboard. Real alpha outside and through fine blade gaps.

Botanically plausible NONWOODY DEERGRASS ROOT/BASE ONLY: a short dense matted fibrous bunchgrass crown with countless VERY THIN tan leaf sheaths and straw fibers, plus a collar of SHORT SLENDER GREEN BLADES that taper naturally to fine pointed tips. Root contact is a low softly uneven compressed fibrous underside; few fine root hairs at the very bottom. All straw and roots look like thin grass fibers, NOT solid cylindrical stalks. Sparse short outer blades arch low left/right, while central short fine green blades make a DENSE SOFT LEAF-SHEATH COLLAR so the narrow tan basal bundles of the supplied upper fans can later sit BEHIND this collar and be occluded naturally. Crown is broad, low and continuous, not two separate rootballs or a hollow ring. Upper fan attachment will be hidden in this natural overlapping fibrous collar, so DO NOT draw engineered sockets or visible branch ends.

ABSOLUTELY NO woody trunk, logs, bark, cut sticks, bamboo, thick reed tubes, posts, round cut-end disks, sawed flat stem tops, branch forks or solid stub cylinders. NO upright tall leaves that duplicate the supplied fans, no flowers, plumes, inflorescence stalks, broad iris leaves or exposed dirt block. No woodgrain or rings anywhere. This replacement fixes a previous crown incorrectly drawn as cut wood; correct it using only fine botanical grass fibers and pointed narrow green blades.

Detailed restrained naturalistic PIXEL ART with deliberate crisp square clusters and stepped fine contours, controlled short value ramps, no smooth photographic airbrushing or uniform noisy dithering. Root/crown art will stay rigid while the existing separate fans rotate gently about buried base pivots. Produce one complete low fibrous root crown only, broad enough to hide both fan attachment bundles. Maintain clear visible contact underside, no clipped tips or giant decorative shadow. No newly drawn animation frames or physics claim.

generation.prompt_exact:
Create ONE actual production sheet1536x1024 containing EXACTLY FOUR complete isolated functional garden utility objects, arranged strict2x2 with generous transparent clearance. Consistent original collection: lightly weathered warm-silver CEDAR plus MATTE SAGE-GREEN powder-coated metal, small dark fasteners, restrained warm upper-left daylight, three-quarter front garden view with modest top visibility, upright verticals. Detailed naturalistic pixel art with deliberate connected square/stepped pixel clusters and subtly dark contours, controlled woodgrain and material shading, no photographic airbrush or glitter-noise. The three supplied internal project sprites show cedar grain, simple metal construction, and green metal hardware/pixel style. Do not reproduce the referenced potting bench, seat or feeder. Create the four new utility forms below, all matching palette/perspective/light. Dry static objects only; no wet/open/action variants.
TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside silhouettes and through all actual open handle/hook/leg gaps. No fake checkerboard, colored matte, backdrop or radial haze. Only tight tiny ground shadows for actual ground-standing objects. The wall-mounted rail has no pretend freestanding feet or ground shadow. No plants, pots, tools hanging on hooks, birdseed piles, poured water, characters, birds, UI, numbers, text, labels, logos, scenery or yard. Entire silhouettes and all hardware stay within their own quadrant, at least80px alpha clearance from quadrant boundaries, no overlap or clipping. Do not normalize every object to fill equal boxes: think roughly600 native pixels per meter, allowing detail. Functional object scale relationships remain sensible.
TOP LEFT: EMPTY WALL-MOUNTED TOOL RAIL. One horizontal weathered cedar backboard about0.8m wide and0.14m tall, four short matching sage-green J-shaped hooks screwed to its front face. Four equally spaced visible hook openings and tips; two discrete metal wall-mount plates/holes or screw heads near the backboard ends. No attached tools, shelves, bench or legs. All four individual hooks visibly exposed and complete; no giant deep ornamental curls. Board perhaps450-500px wide and100-130px tall including hooks, modest top wood edge visible. It is a suspended wall fixture that requires a wall support.
TOP RIGHT: LOW GARDEN STEP STOOL. One compact sturdy one-step utility platform about0.45m wide,0.30m deep and0.28m high, two broad flat weathered cedar top planks on a matte sage-green metal frame with four short angled legs/feet, simple small side brace. No chair back, no armrests, no potting surface or second shelf. Flat lightly textured step surface, complete feet, true-alpha open space under the top and between legs. Deliberately lower/smaller than a seating bench, around280px wide and180px high at shared approximate scale.
BOTTOM LEFT: CLOSED LIDDED SEED-STORAGE CANISTER. One small cylindrical matte sage-green metal utility container about0.36m high and0.26m diameter, tight fitted closed metal lid with a short cedar grip knob, one simple side carry handle with a small cedar grip section and a real alpha opening, one small dark lid latch and subtle lid/body seam. Plain unlabelled body, no feeder tray/feeding ports, no water tap or spout, no visible contents or seed pile. All lid/grip/carry hardware clearly visible. Believable sealed storage form, around220px tall and170px bodywide, not an oversized rain barrel.
BOTTOM RIGHT: SMALL GARDEN WATERING CAN. Matte sage-green oval metal body, slim gently curving long spout ending in a small perforated rose, one high arched carrying handle with a short cedar grip segment. TRUE ALPHA inside the carrying-handle arch and between spout and body. Small dark open fill-mouth interior on top, body empty/dry with no visible liquid, no stream, drips or flow effect. Overall about0.55m long including spout and0.35m high including arch, around340px long and220px high. Distinct portable hand-poured vessel, no hose, wheels or fixed irrigation mechanism. Complete rose/spout tip and arched handle fit with generous alpha clearance.
Maintain matching sage metal and weathered cedar accents across all four. No duplicate filler objects, no fifth object, no assembly instruction diagram. Calm detailed practical yard props; actual isolated RGBA art only.

Create ONE actual production sheet1536x1024 containing EXACTLY FOUR complete isolated functional garden utility objects, arranged strict2x2 with generous transparent clearance. Consistent original collection: lightly weathered warm-silver CEDAR plus MATTE SAGE-GREEN powder-coated metal, small dark fasteners, restrained warm upper-left daylight, three-quarter front garden view with modest top visibility, upright verticals. Detailed naturalistic pixel art with deliberate connected square/stepped pixel clusters and subtly dark contours, controlled woodgrain and material shading, no photographic airbrush or glitter-noise. The three supplied internal project sprites show cedar grain, simple metal construction, and green metal hardware/pixel style. Do not reproduce the referenced potting bench, seat or feeder. Create the four new utility forms below, all matching palette/perspective/light. Dry static objects only; no wet/open/action variants.
TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside silhouettes and through all actual open handle/hook/leg gaps. No fake checkerboard, colored matte, backdrop or radial haze. Only tight tiny ground shadows for actual ground-standing objects. The wall-mounted rail has no pretend freestanding feet or ground shadow. No plants, pots, tools hanging on hooks, birdseed piles, poured water, characters, birds, UI, numbers, text, labels, logos, scenery or yard. Entire silhouettes and all hardware stay within their own quadrant, at least80px alpha clearance from quadrant boundaries, no overlap or clipping. Do not normalize every object to fill equal boxes: think roughly600 native pixels per meter, allowing detail. Functional object scale relationships remain sensible.
TOP LEFT: EMPTY WALL-MOUNTED TOOL RAIL. One horizontal weathered cedar backboard about0.8m wide and0.14m tall, four short matching sage-green J-shaped hooks screwed to its front face. Four equally spaced visible hook openings and tips; two discrete metal wall-mount plates/holes or screw heads near the backboard ends. No attached tools, shelves, bench or legs. All four individual hooks visibly exposed and complete; no giant deep ornamental curls. Board perhaps450-500px wide and100-130px tall including hooks, modest top wood edge visible. It is a suspended wall fixture that requires a wall support.
TOP RIGHT: LOW GARDEN STEP STOOL. One compact sturdy one-step utility platform about0.45m wide,0.30m deep and0.28m high, two broad flat weathered cedar top planks on a matte sage-green metal frame with four short angled legs/feet, simple small side brace. No chair back, no armrests, no potting surface or second shelf. Flat lightly textured step surface, complete feet, true-alpha open space under the top and between legs. Deliberately lower/smaller than a seating bench, around280px wide and180px high at shared approximate scale.
BOTTOM LEFT: CLOSED LIDDED SEED-STORAGE CANISTER. One small cylindrical matte sage-green metal utility container about0.36m high and0.26m diameter, tight fitted closed metal lid with a short cedar grip knob, one simple side carry handle with a small cedar grip section and a real alpha opening, one small dark lid latch and subtle lid/body seam. Plain unlabelled body, no feeder tray/feeding ports, no water tap or spout, no visible contents or seed pile. All lid/grip/carry hardware clearly visible. Believable sealed storage form, around220px tall and170px bodywide, not an oversized rain barrel.
BOTTOM RIGHT: SMALL GARDEN WATERING CAN. Matte sage-green oval metal body, slim gently curving long spout ending in a small perforated rose, one high arched carrying handle with a short cedar grip segment. TRUE ALPHA inside the carrying-handle arch and between spout and body. Small dark open fill-mouth interior on top, body empty/dry with no visible liquid, no stream, drips or flow effect. Overall about0.55m long including spout and0.35m high including arch, around340px long and220px high. Distinct portable hand-poured vessel, no hose, wheels or fixed irrigation mechanism. Complete rose/spout tip and arched handle fit with generous alpha clearance.
Maintain matching sage metal and weathered cedar accents across all four. No duplicate filler objects, no fifth object, no assembly instruction diagram. Calm detailed practical yard props; actual isolated RGBA art only.
